items.title: Whole Vault
items.description: Optionally include notes in subfolders, shown by their path. Hidden folders like .obsidian are skipped.

items.title: One-Tap Capture
items.description: Pick a default file and the Add task widget opens it straight away.

items.title: Custom Statuses
items.description: Tasks like [/], [-] or [w] are shown, and you can set them with a long press.

items.title: Scheduled in Daily Focus
items.description: Tasks scheduled for today or earlier now appear in Daily Focus.

items.title: Line Endings Kept
items.description: Saving a note keeps its CRLF or LF line endings and its final newline.
